su-tpia-1366088066.d:
DevOps & AI Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purposes:

The DevOps & AI Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for hands-on engineering of CI/CD pipelines, AI/RPA solutions, Power Platform applications, and integrations across the Non-SAP landscape in Indonesia. The role partners with the Team Lead and other towers to deliver automation and AI initiatives end-to-end.

Key responsibilities include:

DevOps & CI/CD Engineering:
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) for custom applications, integrations, and Power Platform solutions.
• Implement Infrastructure-as-Code, secrets management, and environment promotion practices.
• Operate observability for in-scope workloads (logs, metrics, alerts).

AI, RPA & Power Platform Delivery:
• Develop and operationalize AI/ML use cases on Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or Azure ML — including prompt engineering, retrieval, evaluation, and basic guardrails.
• Build and maintain RPA bots and workflow automations (Power Automate, UiPath, or similar).
• Develop Power Apps (canvas/model-driven) and Power Automate flows; manage Dataverse models and ALM.

Integration & App Support:
• Develop and support REST/SOAP integrations across SAP, COTS, and custom systems.
• Provide L2/L3 support for in-scope automations and AI workloads; perform RCA and stabilization.

Coordination & Improvement:
• Coordinate / oversee Kyndryl and other 3P partners on assigned deliverables; validate code and configuration.
• Mentor junior engineers (where present), promote reusable components, and contribute to runbooks and architecture diagrams.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on application development, DevOps, or automation experience.
• Working knowledge of CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), Git, and Microsoft Azure (App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Storage).
• Hands-on experience in AT LEAST TWO of: AI/ML (Azure OpenAI / Copilot Studio / Azure ML), RPA (Power Automate, UiPath), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse), API/integration platforms.
• Familiar with ITIL change/release/incident processes.
• Relevant certifications (AZ-204, AI-102, PL-400, PL-200) are a plus.
• Strong communication in Bahasa Indonesia; working-level English sufficient for documentation, ticket handling, and coordination with regional/3P teams.

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

wo-klbf-JR26_001289.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
